description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Darius''' empowers his next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] within 4 seconds to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]], gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 25 '''bonus''' range, deal '''bonus''' physical damage and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]] the target by 90% for 1 second. This damage is affected by [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critical strike]] modifiers.
description.text: Active: Darius empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain  25 bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and slow the target by 90% for 1 second. This damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.

description2.raw: If this attack kills the target, half of ''Crippling Strike's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown is reduced and its [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana cost is refunded.
description2.text: If this attack kills the target, half of Crippling Strike's  cooldown is reduced and its  mana cost is refunded.

description3.raw: ''Crippling Strike [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Darius' ''' basic attack timer.''
description3.text: Crippling Strike resets Darius' basic attack timer.

leveling.raw:

40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60% AD

notes.raw: * ''Crippling Strike'' deals [[File:Basic Attack.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Basic damage]] [[:Damage|basic damage]] but will also trigger [[File:Blackfire Torch item.png|20px|link=Ability effects|An icon representing the keyword Ability effects]] [[:Ability effects|spell effects]] by also being tagged as [[File:Disintegrate.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Spell damage]] [[:Damage|spell damage]]. ** This includes the [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] itself. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shields]] will negate all effects of ''Crippling Strike'', including the damage of the basic attack itself.(unexpected) * The attack's animation can be cancelled by casting [[File:Darius Decimate.png|20xpx|border|link=Darius#Decimate|An icon for Darius's ability Decimate]] [[Darius#Decimate|Decimate]], but the attack will still land. * The cooldown reduction and mana refund will not trigger when killing [[jungle plants]].
notes.text:
Crippling Strike deals basic damage but will also trigger spell effects by also being tagged as spell damage.
* This includes the basic attack itself.
Spell shields will negate all effects of Crippling Strike, including the damage of the basic attack itself.(unexpected)
The attack's animation can be cancelled by casting Decimate, but the attack will still land.
The cooldown reduction and mana refund will not trigger when killing jungle plants.
